apps.title: brrrNews
apps.subtitle: CurrentLens · Current affairs reader
apps.description: A local-first Android news reader with a UPSC-oriented editorial lens, saved stories, reading statistics and quiz practice.
apps.note: Public testing APK. Refer to the repository for current source status and setup details.

apps.title: brrBoard
apps.subtitle: Android keyboard · By MangoLoads
apps.description: A local-first frosted Android keyboard with English and Hinglish typing, Emoji, Clipboard and optional offline voice.
apps.note: Original-signed release. Current package com.mangoloads.board. Normal updates reuse an installed offline voice model rather than bundling weights.

apps.title: expBoard
apps.subtitle: expmango · Lightweight keyboard prototype
apps.description: A small local-first keyboard experiment focused on fast English and Hinglish typing, adaptive vocabulary and typo correction.
apps.note: Experimental debug build. Expect unfinished behaviour and compatibility changes.

apps.title: Liquid Lab
apps.subtitle: liquid · Interactive optics experiment
apps.description: A React and TypeScript laboratory for Liquid Glass optics, ambient illumination, motion and cross-window haze. The APK here is an experimental package.
apps.note: Experimental APK from the visual laboratory; not a general-purpose stable app.

apps.title: Metrolist Fluid
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music client · Personal fork
apps.description: A personalised build of the open-source Metrolist Android client, with a fluid visual treatment and ColorOS-oriented changes.
apps.note: Pre-release personal fork. Not an official build from MetrolistGroup.

apps.title: brrMusic
apps.subtitle: Music player · Personal fork
apps.description: An Android music player fork with locally adaptive stereo processing, audio refinements and ColorOS Fluid Cloud compatibility.
apps.note: Independent Zenith/BitChord-derived fork. Read notes for the experimental processing options and device compatibility.

apps.title: brrSpeak
apps.subtitle: Dictator- · Experimental voice companion
apps.description: A separate experimental Dictate fork for testing brrBoard's record-first speech handoff without keeping another app running.
apps.note: Experimental test package com.mangoloads.speak; not an official upstream distribution and not required for brrBoard's built-in offline mic.

apps.title: AfuseKt
apps.subtitle: InfuseKt-release · Release archive
apps.description: A repository that mirrors release information for the upstream AfuseKt media player. No APK is currently attached to a GitHub Release in this repository.
apps.note: No one-click APK is available from the GitHub Releases endpoint at present. The repository is provided for reference.
